social_circle.name: Camila Vargas

demographics.occupation: Pediatric speech-language pathologist at a Wauwatosa clinic, primarily working with children on the autism spectrum
demographics.education: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP credentialed)

background.how_they_met: Met Osvaldo at a Habitat for Humanity build in 2012; she was framing a wall and roasting one of the site leads for misusing a level, which is the moment Osvaldo describes as deciding she was the person.
background.why_close: Shared immigrant-kid identity (she came to the U.S. from Mexico City at 12), shared Catholic and bilingual home culture, shared Habitat-rooted values around community work, and a confiding marriage in which she is Osvaldo's primary corrective feedback ('Osvaldo, when are you sleeping?'). She enforces his three-volunteer-commitment limit and called him out when he was withdrawing after the November 2025 contract loss.

interests: pediatric SLP work and autism support
zinnias and the Menomonee Falls farmers market
Suzuki violin (her childhood hobby, passed to Lucia)
long-term therapy and personal mental-health practice
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Mix of full sentences and clipped check-ins during the workday; bilingual code-switches into Spanish for endearments and family-coded jokes; uses emoji moderately (heart, eye-roll, taco); occasional voice notes when she is walking Lucia home from school or driving.

shared_activities: Weekend cooking together (especially ceviche)
Saturday Menomonee Falls farmers market
Mass at St. Mary's ~2 Sundays/month
Every-other-Friday date nights when in-laws take Lucia
Annual February couples winter trip
Co-parenting logistics for Lucia (kindergarten, Suzuki, Spanish enrichment)
recent_text_topics: Coordinating Lucia's Monday Spanish enrichment pickup and Thursday Suzuki lesson logistics now that the new senior-associate role has Osvaldo in more late-afternoon BD meetings.
Therapy check-ins and gentle nudges about whether Osvaldo is keeping his three-commitment limit during PE prep season.
Grocery list for the new LDL-friendly diet (oats, fish, less red meat) and which farmers-market vendor has the sourdough Lucia is obsessed with.
Camila's mom watching Lucia for the upcoming Friday date night, plus whether they should drive into Milwaukee for the Ecuadorian place or stay in the Falls.
The Ecuador trip sinking fund — Camila pushed him to actually book dates for next year instead of saying 'next year' again.

social_circle.name: Marisol Vargas-Holcomb

demographics.occupation: Nurse anesthetist (CRNA) at a Madison-area hospital
demographics.education: BSN, plus Master's in Nurse Anesthesia

background.how_they_met: Sibling — two years younger than Osvaldo; grew up together in Queens and then Milwaukee's south side (27th and Lincoln) after the family's move when he was about ten.
background.why_close: Osvaldo explicitly calls her his best friend and the only person who can tell him to slow down and have him actually listen. Shared first-gen Ecuadorian-American upbringing, shared experience of their father's 2021 death and managing their mother's grief afterward, and roughly parallel parenting stages (her four-year-old twin boys, his six-year-old).

interests: clinical anesthesia and ICU-adjacent gallows humor
Ecuadorian cooking from their mother's recipes
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: High-volume daily texter; heavy meme and reel forwarding; emoji-rich; sentence fragments; switches into Spanish for inside jokes and when imitating their mother; sends voice notes after long shifts.

shared_activities: Daily meme/venting text thread
Hosting their mom for Sunday lunch on rotation with Osvaldo and Camila
Long-weekend family visits a couple of times a year (her family to Menomonee Falls and vice versa)
Christmas at her place — Osvaldo's annual ~$1,500 holiday travel/gift line item
Coordinating care and emotional support for their mother Gloria
recent_text_topics: Sending memes about kindergarten chaos vs. four-year-old twin chaos and ranking which is worse.
Their mom's recent blood pressure readings on lisinopril and whether the West Allis cardiology follow-up is on the calendar.

Processing year-five-after-Dad feelings — both of them noting how Year 3 was unexpectedly hard and checking in on each other before the anniversary.

social_circle.name: Gloria Vargas

demographics.occupation: Retired commercial office cleaner; now does sewing and alterations on the side from her West Allis condo
demographics.education: Three years of high school in Ecuador; earned GED in the U.S. when Osvaldo was about 12

background.how_they_met: Mother; raised Osvaldo in Queens until the family moved to Milwaukee when he was around ten.

agua de manzanilla and eucalipto remedies
